title: Determining methylation status of methylguanine DNA methyl transferase (MGMT) from formalin-fixed, paraffin embedded tumor tissue
author: de Abreu, Gallagher, et al.

steps.title: Set up and start run
steps.instruction: Configure the instrument software and initiate the PCR run.

substeps.instruction: Click the “Run Method” icon on the left side of the window.
Verify that the reaction volume is set to 20 µL.
Verify the thermal profile matches Table 5; edit if necessary.
Click the “Start Run” icon at the top‑right corner of the screen.
Save the run with a unique file name.

steps.title: Validate analysis parameters
steps.instruction: After the run finishes, check that analysis settings are correct.

substeps.instruction: When the run completes, the software automatically opens the “Analysis” window with all samples selected.
Verify the efficiency of each standard curve for MGMT and ACTB; values must be between 90 % and 110 %.
Verify that the threshold set by the software is the same for all samples and controls.

steps.title: Perform data analysis and export
steps.instruction: Confirm threshold placement, run analysis, and export results.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the threshold lies in the middle of the exponential amplification curve.
Click the “Analysis” icon on the left side of the screen.
Export the results to an Excel file.

steps.title: Export data and calculate PMR
steps.instruction: Save the Excel file, transfer key values, and let the worksheet compute PMR.

substeps.instruction: Click “Start Export”; the file is saved to the Ion folder, then close the window.
Copy the “t” and “Quantity mean” values for each sample from the Analysis file and paste them into the “MGMT Worksheet”.
The worksheet automatically calculates the PMR (Percentage of Methylated Reference).

steps.title: Review calculated values
steps.instruction: Inspect the PMR values for plausibility.

steps.title: Calculate PMR formula
steps.instruction: Use the following equation to compute PMR for each sample: PMR = ((Qsample / Qmethy‑control)MGMT / (Qsample / Qmethy‑control)ACTB) × 100.

steps.title: Interpret methylation status
steps.instruction: Determine methylation based on PMR: PMR ≥ 2 indicates methylated; PMR < 2 indicates unmethylated.
